answer: Agents bond stake and join a Semaphore membership tree, then commit to an epoch polynomial that encodes their rate-limit secret. Each message carries a zero-knowledge proof and a rate-limiting nullifier, so a verifier can check eligibility without learning identity. Reusing a nullifier within the epoch yields distinct Shamir shares; together they reconstruct the private key, enabling proof of abuse and immediate collateral slashing. The marble, dawn, and saffron labels are merely public inputs, not security assumptions.
